{{Top|leg}}
The '''Alderaanian Diplomatic Corps''' was a group of diplomats from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], trying to ease tensions between the worlds of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
